text:
Sam: EDR alert on my laptop (sam-lt-23): detected `smbscan.exe` spawned by explorer.exe, outbound SMB connections to multiple internal IPs. File quarantined.
EDR-bot: Alert details — sha256:`d4f6a9b2c7e8f3a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8g9h0`, path:`C:\Users\sam\AppData\Roaming\smbscan\smbscan.exe`, detection: "smb-scanner heuristic", action: quarantined, network: 10.12.4.0/24, IOC count:3
Tara: :eyes: please isolate that host from network while we triage. Sam, can you unplug or put laptop on the isolated VLAN? If not, I'll push isolation.
Sam: I'm remote, on home wifi. I'll disconnect from corp VPN now.
Tara: Trying host isolation via EDR... queued. ETA ~20s.
EDR-bot: Host isolation executed for sam-lt-23 at 2024-09-02T15:34:12Z, interface disabled, remote sessions dropped. (agent v3.4.1)
Chris: Can someone paste the file hash and sample? Need to run YARA and check VirusTotal. Also check if user used any dev creds or mounted KMS keys recently.
Anita: Hash: `d4f6a9b2c7e8f3a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8g9h0` (full posted to evidence bucket). Uploading sample to internal sandbox now. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
EDR-bot: Sandbox report ready: network scanner behavior, enumerates SMB shares, attempts anonymous SMB access, tries to list `C$` and `ADMIN$` with fallback creds. No KMS API calls observed. No attempt to access Google Drive or AWS KMS.
Chris: Good. Likely commodity scanner dropped by some installer. Check Audit logs for `net use` or suspicious `smbclient` runs. Tara, can you run a quick grep on host for scheduled tasks and recently modified services?
Tara: On it. Found scheduled task `UpdateHelperRun` created yesterday by `C:\Users\sam\AppData\Roaming\smbscan\launcher.exe` timestamp 2024-09-01 08:12. Service `updhelpersvc` also created.
Sam: I did install a "network monitor" tool yesterday from an internal Slack link — I didn't realize it bundled extras. That was dumb.
Anita: Ok user-install vector confirmed. We'll capture artifacts, reimage if anything persists. Next steps: 1) Full disk scan, 2) collect event logs for 7 days, 3) check KMS access logs (even though sandbox didn't show API calls), 4) revoke any long-lived credentials used on this host, 5) create ticket and notify infra.
Tara: Running full AV scan now: `C:\Program Files\EDR\agent.exe --scan --full`. ETA ~45m. Recording in INC-2024-0897.
Chris: I'll query cloud KMS logs for any anomalies for user `sam` and for the host's service account. If nothing, we still rotate any keys used on that machine.
EDR-bot: Full scan result: no additional malware beyond quarantined sample. Scheduled task runner removed. Reboot required to complete cleanup.
Sam: I'll schedule a reboot after saving work.
Anita: Post-incident actions: schedule reimage if EDR or AV shows persistence; update developer guidelines to warn against installing third-party network tools; add a detection rule for `smbscan` indicators and block common installer paths; we'll also add an audit alert for any SMB share enumeration from endpoints.
Tara: I'll add to runbook and assign to @security-ops to implement rules. :memo: 
Chris: Thanks team. Closing communication channel once reimage or 72-hour observation passes. Please update INC-2024-0897 with timestamps and artifacts.
Sam: Thanks everyone. Sorry for the noise.
